records.jp: ……もう、思い残すことはないかな？
records.en_original: Done everything you wanted?
records.en: Done everything you wanted?

records.jp: うん。いよいよお別れだね、この世界とも
records.en_original: Yeah. I think it's time to say goodbye to this world.
records.en: Yeah. I think it's time to say goodbye to this world.

records.jp: もし成功すれば、わたしたちは……<CR>平和な暮らしに戻れるんだよね？
records.en_original: If this works, we'll be able to return to our peaceful lives, right?
records.en: If this works, we'll be able to return to our peaceful lives, right?

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんでもやっぱり不安？
records.en_original: Are you worried, Hiori?
records.en: Are you worried, Hiori-san?

records.jp: 上手くいくって信じてる。<CR>信じてるけど……でもやっぱり不安だよ
records.en_original: I believe it'll work, but I'm still worried.
records.en: I believe it'll work, but I'm still worried.

records.jp: 灰がなくなれば……灰さえなければ、<CR>あたしだって生きられるはずなんだ
records.en_original: If the Ash goes away... If it really goes away, I should be able to live.
records.en: If the Ash goes away... If it really goes away, I should be able to live.

records.jp: でも……そんな簡単な話なのかって、<CR>疑ってる自分もいる……
records.en_original: But part of me still isn't sure it'll be that simple...
records.en: But part of me still isn't sure it'll be that simple...

records.jp: ……うん。それに……ここでの生活も、<CR>元の世界での思い出もなくなっちゃうなんて
records.en_original: Yeah... And we'll lose all of our memories from our lives here and in the old world...
records.en: Yeah... And we'll lose all of our memories from our lives here and in the old world...

records.jp: 望む通りの世界が再構築されるとは限らない
records.en_original: There's no telling if the world will truly be remade according to our wishes.
records.en: There's no telling if the world will truly be remade according to our wishes.

records.jp: それに……再構築後の世界でも、<CR>また同じような人生を送れる保証もない
records.en_original: And there's no guarantee that we'll be able to live the same kind of life in the rebuilt world.
records.en: And there's no guarantee that we'll be able to live the same kind of life in the rebuilt world.

records.jp: もしかすると……元の世界の友人と、<CR>新しい世界では友人になれないかもしれない
records.en_original: There's a chance we may never meet our acquaintances from the old world in the new one.
records.en: There's a chance we may never meet our acquaintances from the old world in the new one.

records.jp: 久野さん……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en: Kuno-san...

records.jp: もし私が、新しい世界で生きていけるとしても……<CR>皆さんとは、出会わないほうがいいでしょうね
records.en_original: If I'm able to continue living in the new world, it may be best for me not to see you all again.
records.en: If I'm able to continue living in the new world, it may be best for me not to see you all again.

records.jp: まだそんなこと言ってるの？<CR>なんにも気にしてないのに！
records.en_original: Are you still talking like that? Nobody here wants that!
records.en: Are you still talking like that? Nobody here wants that!

records.jp: わ、私が気にするんですっ！
records.en_original: I-I can't help but worry about it!
records.en: I-I can't help but worry about it!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？　何か考えてる？
records.en_original: What's on your mind, Ao?
records.en: What's on your mind, Ao-chan?

records.jp: ん？　ああ……
records.en_original: Hmm? Oh...
records.en: Hmm? Oh...

records.jp: たしかに、私も不安だなって思う。<CR>でも……それと同じくらい、期待もしてる
records.en_original: I'm a little nervous too, but I'm also hopeful at the same time.
records.en: I'm a little nervous too, but I'm also hopeful at the same time.

records.jp: 期待？
records.en_original: Hopeful?
records.en: Hopeful?

records.jp: ……なんだろう、ふわっとしてるんだけど――
records.en_original: How should I put it, I feel...uplifted.
records.en: How should I put it, I feel...uplifted.

records.jp: 飽きるほど聞いたセミの声も
records.en_original: The sounds of cicadas that used to drive me crazy...
records.en: The sounds of cicadas that used to drive me crazy...

records.jp: 毎日変わり映えのしない通学路も
records.en_original: The same boring walk to and from school, every single day...
records.en: The same boring walk to and from school, every single day...

records.jp: 嫌だった補習も
records.en_original: All those stupid supplementary lessons...
records.en: All those stupid supplementary lessons...

records.jp: ずっと退屈だと思ってたあの世界だって、<CR>きっと今なら輝いて見えると思うんだ
records.en_original: Something tells me that the world that was always so boring will somehow seem brighter now.
records.en: Something tells me that the world that was always so boring will somehow seem brighter now.

records.jp: だから、楽しみ。<CR>私はそう思ってるよ
records.en_original: That's why I'm looking forward to it.
records.en: That's why I'm looking forward to it.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en: Ao-chan...

records.jp: うん、きっとそうだね
records.en_original: Yeah, you're right.
records.en: Yeah, you're right.

records.jp: 世界の、終焉…………
records.en_original: The world is dying...
records.en: The world is dying...

records.jp: ……結局、最後まで愛央ちゃんに助けられちゃった
records.en_original: In the end...it was Ao that saved us.
records.en: In the end...it was Ao-chan that saved us.

records.jp: そうですね。<CR>今のわたしたちがいるのは……星崎さんのおかげです
records.en_original: Indeed. Ao is the reason I am who I am now.
records.en: Indeed. Hoshizaki-san is the reason I am who I am now.

records.jp: 愛央がいなければできなかったことがたくさんある
records.en_original: There's so much we never could have done without her.
records.en: There's so much we never could have done without her.

records.jp: ……私は、あんまりその実感はないんだけどね
records.en_original: It doesn't really feel that way to me.
records.en: It doesn't really feel that way to me.

records.jp: それでも、なのです
records.en_original: But it's true.
records.en: But it's true.

records.jp: ありがとう、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao.
records.en: Thank you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: こころ……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: ……私こそ、だよ
records.en_original: I should be thanking you...
records.en: I should be thanking you...

records.jp: 私、この世界に来てからずっと考えてた。<CR>こんな平凡な私に何ができるんだろうって
records.en_original: Ever since I came here, I've worried about what a normal girl like me could possibly do.
records.en: Ever since I came here, I've worried about what a normal girl like me could possibly do.

records.jp: 柄にもなくリーダーなんかやっちゃったりしてさ。<CR>こんな私だから、やっぱり大失敗もしちゃったりして
records.en_original: I was never cut out to be a leader. I made my fair share of big mistakes because of that.
records.en: I was never cut out to be a leader. I made my fair share of big mistakes because of that.

records.jp: それでもここまで来れたのは、みんなのおかげ。<CR>みんなが支えてくれたから、私は今ここに立ってる
records.en_original: But the reason we're here is thanks to you all. I never would have made it without your support.
records.en: But the reason we're here is thanks to you all. I never would have made it without your support.

records.jp: みんなと出会って、この世界を回って、<CR>いろんな記憶を見て、みんなの大切を知って
records.en_original: Because I came here and met all of you, learned what you all care about through your memories...
records.en: Because I came here and met all of you, learned what you all care about through your memories...

records.jp: そうしてたくさんの想いに触れて、私は……
records.en_original: Felt all of your emotions...
records.en: Felt all of your emotions...

records.jp: 私はたぶん、退屈な毎日を過ごしてた頃とは<CR>違う自分になれたんだ
records.en_original: I'm a different person that the one who used to spend all her days in boredom.
records.en: I'm a different person that the one who used to spend all her days in boredom.

records.jp: 私……何かできたのかな。<CR>みんなに何か、返せたのかな……
records.en_original: I wonder if there's anything more I could have done...if there's anything I could have given back to everyone...
records.en: I wonder if there's anything more I could have done...if there's anything I could have given back to everyone...

records.jp: たくさん貰ったよ。<CR>愛央が思うより、ずっとたくさん
records.en_original: You gave us a lot, Ao. So much more than you could possibly realize.
records.en: You gave us a lot, Ao. So much more than you could possibly realize.

records.jp: 星崎さんがいたから、わたしたちはつながれたんです
records.en_original: We are all connected here thanks to you.
records.en: It was because you were here, Hoshizaki-san, that we were able to connect.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんから貰った想いで<CR>私たちはつながって……結ばれてるんだよ
records.en_original: The feelings we got from you are what connects us, what binds us, Ao.
records.en: The feelings we got from you are what connects us, what binds us, Ao-chan.

records.jp: みんな……
records.en_original: Everyone...
records.en: Everyone...

records.jp: ありがとう
records.en_original: Thank you.
records.en: Thank you.

records.jp: ……これが本当の最後。<CR>気づけば、あっという間の夏休みだった
records.en_original: This is really the end. Summer vacation was over before I knew it.
records.en: This is really the end. Summer vacation was over before I knew it.

records.jp: でも、私たちは結ばれてる
records.en_original: But our connection is strong.
records.en: But our connection is strong.

records.jp: 私たちが、それぞれの日常に戻ったとしても……<CR>それだけは絶対に変わらない
records.en_original: Even if we go back to our own daily lives, that fact will never change.
records.en: Even if we go back to our own daily lives, that fact will never change.

records.jp: だから、怖くない
records.en_original: That's why I'm not afraid.
records.en: That's why I'm not afraid.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: みんな――
records.en_original: Everyone...
records.en: Everyone...

records.jp: 行ってらっしゃい
records.en_original: Until we meet again.
records.en: Until we meet again.
